name: darwin-skill
title_zh: 用九维评分自动迭代你的 SKILL.md 直到它变强
tagline_zh: 你的 skill 写完后没人用？让达尔文式爬山算法自己改自己，每次改动都有 git 留痕，九维评分当裁判。
tagline_en: Your SKILL.md stuck at v1? Let hill-climbing rewrite it, scored on 9 axes with git history, and you just approve.
desc_en: Darwin Skill 2.0 (达尔文.skill 2.0): autonomous skill optimizer, v2.0 integrates Microsoft Research SkillLens (arXiv 2605.23899) 9-dim rubric + SkillOpt (arXiv 2605.23904) validation-gated design + human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Evaluates SKILL.md files using a 9-dimension rubric (structure + effectiveness + meta-skill blacklists), runs hill-climbing with git version control, spawns independent judge
why_zh: 不是模板生成器，是带验证门的优化器：SkillLens 九维打分 + SkillOpt 爬山搜索。
why_en: Not a template filler—a validation-gated optimizer: SkillLens 9-axis scoring plus SkillOpt hill-climbing, with an independent.
limit_zh: 只改 SKILL.md 文本，不碰代码逻辑；需要本机有 git 和可用的 LLM API；评分依赖 SkillLens。
limit_en: Edits SKILL.md text only, not code; requires git + a working LLM API; scoring depends on SkillLens model—offline means it stops; no cross-domain.
